title: Sound Pocket
summary: A speaker type of circuit sculpture that visualizes sound through LED light panels and creates acoustic distortion through an adjustable metal reflector placed in front of the speaker module.

paragraph: Sound Pocket is a circuit-sculpture speaker that translates sound into light.
Its three-dimensional circuitry functions as an audio amplifier, while LED panels at the base respond to the audio signal.
A metal reflector above the speaker can be adjusted in height and tilt to alter how sound is reflected, creating acoustic distortion.
Inspired by the glass catfish, whose internal organs are visible through its transparent body, Sound Pocket houses its circuitry in a clear acrylic cylinder.
Instead of lying flat on a printed circuit board, the electronic components form a three-dimensional structure, resembling organs within a transparent body.
Three Sound Pocket speakers were used in WOW-Flow at ZER01NE DAY 2022 and in Widening Waves as part of Random Access Project 3.0 at the Nam June Paik Art Center in 2023.
